summary: Type a domain or URL to see its site's icon and copy it as a PNG up to 256 pixels, or as an ICO, from Google's and DuckDuckGo's favicon services.
notes: Reads t1.gstatic.com and icons.duckduckgo.com only when you choose Copy. Google sends the largest icon it has up to the size you pick, never enlarged. Sites a service has no icon for, or no ICO, can't be copied. A site's own SVG or touch icon is out of reach, since Volant lets extensions read only the hosts they list. Copying needs Volant 0.3.35 or later; older versions open the icon in your browser instead. Not affiliated with Google or DuckDuckGo. Needs Volant 0.3.36 or later, which shows each icon in its row and copies whatever image type DuckDuckGo sends.
